vendor |quest_reward3_quest = Fallen from Grace |quest_reward3_quest_id = a6q4 |quest_reward3_act = 6 |quest_reward3_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Fireball''' is a [[spell]] that fires a [[projectile]], dealing [[fire damage]] with an increased chance to {{stl|Ignite}}. ==Skill functions and interactions== * '''[[Area of Effect]]''': The radius of the explosion caused by collision (with either an enemy or a terrain obstruction) is affected by all AoE increases, with a base radius of 9.https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/auyizx/aoe_radius_should_have_two_decimal_places/ehfj02a/ Full spell damage is done to any enemy in range of the explosion. * '''[[Piercing|Pierce]]''', '''[[Chaining|Chain]]''', '''[[Fork]]''': Enemies hit by a projectile that pierces, chains, or forks will take full damage from the hit, but the projectile will not explode until it hits an enemy and does not pierce, chain, or fork, or hits a wall. * Shotgunning: Each enemy can only be hit directly by one projectile per cast. However, if an enemy is in range of the explosion effect of more than one projectile from the same cast, and those projectiles each exploded on different enemies or a wall, it will take full damage from each explosion. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Fire
damage |c1_header = Deals x to y Fire Damage |c1_pattern_extract = Deals (%d+) to (%d+) Fire Damage |c1_pattern_value = %d to %d |c2_abbr = Radius |c2_header = Base radius is x metres |c2_pattern_extract = Base radius is (%d+%.*%d*) metres? |c2_pattern_value = %.1fm }} {{Item acquisition}} In addition, Fireball is the starting skill gem for [[Witch]]. It drops after killing the first monster of the game, [[Hungry Corpse]]. {{Skill threshold jewel list|stat_id=fireball}} {{Skill enchantment modifier list}} {{Alternate skill effect list}} ==Monsters== [[Monster]]s using this skill: * [[Goatman Fire-raiser]] * [[Flame Sentinel]] + {{il|Lesser Multiple Projectiles Support}} * [[Solar Guard]] and [[Prayer Guard]] * [[Solar Elemental]] (as fireball nova) ==Version history== Fireball is the first skill in the game, introduced during alpha. Items such as {{il|Replica Dragonfang's Flight}} allocate a numeric value of 1 for the skill. {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.29.0| * Fireball: Base radius is now 1-1.8 metres at gem levels 1-20 (previously 0.9-1.4), has a Critical Strike Chance of 5% (previously 6%), and the base Mana Cost has been reduced by 20% at all gem levels. Now has 480% Effectiveness of Added Damage at gem level 20 (previously 370%), and now deals 1883 to 2825 Fire Damage at gem level 20 (previously 1640 to 2460). Quality is now +0-0.3 metres to Radius (previously +0-0.2). }} {{Version history table row|3.25.0| * Now has 260% Effectiveness of Added Damage at gem level 1, scaling up to 370% at gem level 20 (previously 370% at all gem levels). }} {{Version history table row|3.23.0| * Now has a base Radius of 0.9 metres at gem level 1 (unchanged), scaling up to 1.4 metres at gem level 20 (previously 1 metre). * No longer has Projectiles gain radius as they travel farther, up to a maximum of +0-0.9 metres to radius. * Quality now provides +0-0.2 metres to radius, instead of 0-20% increased Projectile Speed. }} {{Version history table row|3.17.0| * Fireball now deals 9 to 14 Fire Damage at gem level 1 (unchanged), up to 1640 to 2460 at gem level 20 (previously 1095 to 1643). * Now has 370% Effectiveness of Added Damage at all gem levels (previously 240%). }} {{Version history table row|3.16.0| * No longer has 50-88% more Damage with Ignite.
